title: Notification regarding Special Division bench of Hon'ble The Chief Justice and Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh on 9th October, 2026 at 10:30 AM.

HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 8th October, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ It is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that there will be a Special Division Bench of Hon’ble The Chief Justice and
Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh on 09-10-2026 at 10:30 am only for delivery of
judgement/order in CrI. A. No, 12 of 2026 \Chingakham Basanta P£ National Investigation
/lge/7c/] .
The Regular Division Bench shall sit after the rising of the Special Division Bench.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
